chunks: The prescribed penalty (hadd) of lashing in fornication/adultery (zina) is that the two are found in one blanket, and the two men are found in one blanket, and the two women are found in one blanket.

key_terms.الزِّنَى: zina — unlawful sexual intercourse (fornication or adultery) prohibited by Islamic law
key_terms.حَدُّ الْجَلْدِ: hadd of lashing — the Quranic prescribed punishment of flogging, applied in cases of proven or evidentially established illicit sexual conduct
key_terms.لِحَافٍ وَاحِدٍ: one blanket/quilt — a single shared covering, which serves as physical evidence of impropriety in this context

ai.seo_question: What is the hadd punishment for being found under one blanket in Islamic jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) defines the evidentiary threshold that triggers the hadd lashing penalty in cases of illicit sexual conduct. The ruling establishes that the discovery of a man and woman (or two men, or two women) sharing a blanket constitutes sufficient grounds to apply the hadd of lashing, even without direct evidence of the act itself. This reflects the classical Shia jurisprudential approach of applying lesser penalties (lashing rather than stoning) when full evidentiary proof of penetration is absent — a safeguard against both indecency and unjust severe punishment.
